description.en: Record decisions as notes, follow their status and see them on a timeline.
description.zh-TW: 把決策記成筆記、追蹤狀態，並用時間軸檢視。
description.zh-CN: 把决策记成笔记、跟踪状态，并用时间轴查看。

tools.name: record_decision
tools.description: Record a decision as NNNN-title.md (context, options considered, decision, consequences). Without a tree it goes in decisions/; with one, in that tree's decisions folder (numbered per folder). Use status "proposed" unless a person agreed.

tree.description: Decision tree, e.g. a project name like "Prism" (see list_decision_trees); omit for records in no tree.

branch.description: A line of decisions that runs next to the main one, like a git branch (e.g. "4.x"). Omit for the main line; a record that supersedes one on a branch stays on it.

supersedes.description: The record this one replaces: its number ("0003", looked up in the same tree first), a path or Tree#number.

requires.description: Records this one needs, possibly in other trees: "Prism#0003" (tree#number), a path, or a number in the same tree.

language.description: Language of the section headings (default en).

tools.name: list_decisions
tools.description: List decision records (NNNN-title.md in any decisions/ folder) with number, title, status, date, deciders, tree, folder; supersedesPath, requiresPaths and requiredBy link records across trees. At most 150 records are read; truncated says when there were more.

tree.description: Only this tree ("" = records in no tree).

tools.name: update_decision_status
tools.description: Change the status of a decision (proposed, accepted, superseded, rejected).

id.description: The record: its path, "Tree#0003", or a number when only one record has it.

tools.name: list_decision_trees
tools.description: List the decision trees (one per project or area) and how many decisions each holds.
